from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scintillation.scint_analysis.core import DynamicSpectrum

src_dir = Path('/Users/jakobfaber/Data/Faber2026/dsa110/upchan_codetections')
out_dir = Path('/Users/jakobfaber/Data/Faber2026/dsa110/scintillation-data')
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
raw = np.load(src_dir / 'freya_chime_upchan.npy')
freqs = np.load(src_dir / 'freya_chime_freq.npy')
dt = 2 * 2.56e-6 * 64
times = np.arange(raw.shape[1], dtype=np.float64) * dt
assert raw.shape == (freqs.size, times.size)
assert np.all(np.diff(freqs) > 0)

full_path = out_dir / 'freya_chime.npz'
hi_path = out_dir / 'freya_chime_hi.npz'
np.savez_compressed(
    full_path,
    power_2d=np.flip(raw, axis=0),
    frequencies_mhz=freqs,
    times_s=times,
)
hi = (freqs >= 600.0) & (freqs <= 800.0)
np.savez_compressed(
    hi_path,
    power_2d=np.flip(raw[hi], axis=0),
    frequencies_mhz=freqs[hi],
    times_s=times,
)

for label, path, expected_power, expected_freqs in [
    ('full', full_path, raw, freqs),
    ('hi', hi_path, raw[hi], freqs[hi]),
]:
    with np.load(path) as z:
        print(label, 'keys', list(z.keys()))
        print(label, 'stored shape', z['power_2d'].shape, 'freq first,last,diff', float(z['frequencies_mhz'][0]), float(z['frequencies_mhz'][-1]), float(np.median(np.diff(z['frequencies_mhz']))), 'time dt', float(np.median(np.diff(z['times_s']))))
    ds = DynamicSpectrum.from_numpy_file(path)
    loaded = ds.power.filled(np.nan)
    same = np.allclose(loaded, expected_power, equal_nan=True)
    print(label, 'loader_equals_raw_order', same, 'loaded freq first,last', float(ds.frequencies[0]), float(ds.frequencies[-1]))
    prof = np.nanmean(loaded, axis=0)
    local = np.arange(prof.size)
    noise = prof[:180]
    med = np.nanmedian(noise)
    sig = 1.4826 * np.nanmedian(np.abs(noise - med))
    snr = (prof - med) / sig
    near = np.flatnonzero((snr > 3) & (local >= 200) & (local <= 310))
    gt5 = np.flatnonzero((snr > 5) & (local >= 200) & (local <= 310))
    print(label, 'local_peak_bin', int(local[200:311][np.nanargmax(snr[200:311])]), 'local_peak_snr', float(np.nanmax(snr[200:311])))
    print(label, 'local_gt3_span_count', (int(near.min()), int(near.max()), int(near.size)) if near.size else None, 'local_gt5_count', int(gt5.size))
    for lo, hi2 in [(400, 500), (500, 600), (600, 700), (700, 800)]:
        mask = (ds.frequencies >= lo) & (ds.frequencies < hi2)
        if np.any(mask):
            band_prof = np.nanmean(loaded[mask], axis=0)
            bnoise = band_prof[:180]
            bmed = np.nanmedian(bnoise)
            bsig = 1.4826 * np.nanmedian(np.abs(bnoise - bmed))
            bsnr = (band_prof - bmed) / bsig
            print(label, 'band', f'{lo}-{hi2}', 'near_peak_bin', int(local[200:311][np.nanargmax(bsnr[200:311])]), 'near_peak_snr', float(np.nanmax(bsnr[200:311])))
PY
